title: Citrus, Prosciutto, and Confit Potatoes Recipe Guide
description: This guide outlines the preparation steps for preparing citrus ingredients, marinating them with naval oranges, and confiting sliced prosciutto in seasoned potatoes. It details the cutting techniques for the fruit and the slow-cooking method for the meat and potatoes.
summary: The process begins by preparing a citrus ingredient, involving scooping out seeds, cutting into wedges, and avoiding the white pith. These pieces are then marinated with naval oranges for at least an hour, ideally overnight. The second main component involves preparing prosciutto, which is peeled and sliced into rounds using a mandoline. These slices are then confited in a nonstick pan over medium heat, fully coating the bottom of the pan with oil before layering in potatoes, seasoning with salt, and topping with additional olive oil. The mixture is cooked slowly until the potatoes are soft, and the top is seasoned with extra salt before the dish is finished.

title: Pork Curry Recipe and Savory Pasta Preparation
description: This video provides step-by-step instructions for cooking pork chops with a red curry sauce, along with a subsequent guide for making a savory sauce base and a garlic oil pasta dish.
summary: The video first details the preparation of pork chops and a red curry dish. For the pork, the instructions advise cooking it over medium-low heat, brushing the pan, and then increasing the heat to medium-high to achieve a good sear. After searing and seasoning the pork, it is moved to a separate pan. The next step involves adding red curry paste to the pan over medium heat, cooking it down, increasing the heat to medium-high, and finally adding a can of coconut milk. The instructions then pivot to a savory sauce technique, advising users to scrape the bottom of the pan for fond, boiling the solids, adding pork back in, and simmering over medium-low for 3 to 4 minutes. The recipe suggests optional additions like palm sugar and lime juice. The segment concludes by transitioning abruptly to instructions for making a garlic oil pasta, which involves cooking bucatini or spaghetti, tossing with olive oil and garlic over medium-low heat.
